SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY
B. D. 7032
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date October 23, 35

Subject Newspaper report on the return from abroad of Mr. Kung-chen Ko
(戈公振), a Chinese journalist.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by D S S Copil

With reference to the attached newspaper cutting
of the North China Daily News dated 18.10.35 on the return from
abroad of a prominent Chinese journalist named Kung-chen Ko,
I have to state that Mr. Ko, at the request of the Central
Publicity Department, accompanied the Lytton Commission back
to Geneva in 1932 to attend the deliberations of the League
of Nations on the Report on the Manchurian imbroglio. He
was later appointed by the Chinese Press Association in Shanghai
to represent China at the World Press Congress held at Madrid
and then called on the executives of various news agencies in
France, Italy, Germany, Austria, Czecho-Slovak and the U.S.S.R.
to discuss the exchange of news with Chinese news associations.
During his three years' stay abroad, he spent the greater part
of his time in Russia and returned to Shanghai via Vladivostock
on the s.s. Sever on October 15, 1935. Following his arrival
here, he stayed in the New Asia Hotel, 422 Tiendoong Road.
He became indisposed on October 19 and died at 2 p.m. October 22
of peritonitis after an operation at the Hungjao Road Sanatarian.

Discreet enquiries made by the undersigned show
that Ko's mission abroad was purely for an extensive study of
journalism and there is no reason to believe that he ever
entertained radical political tendencies. His personal conduct
has won the admiration of his acquaintances and colleagues.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

File
24 OCT. 1935

报告
日期：1935年10月23日

事由：关于中国记者戈公振先生从海外归来的报纸报道。

呈报人：督察 顾宝华 转呈人：副督察长 柯璧斯

兹就随附的1935年10月18日《字林西报》剪报，提及一位名为戈公振的著名中国记者从海外归来一事，本人谨陈述如下：戈先生应中央宣传部之请，于1932年陪同李顿调查团返回日内瓦，出席国际联盟关于满洲事变报告的审议会议。此后，他由上海中国新闻记者协会委派，代表中国参加在马德里举行的世界报业大会，随后拜访了法国、意大利、德国、奥地利、捷克斯洛伐克及苏联各通讯社的主管人员，商讨与中国新闻机构进行新闻交换事宜。在出国逗留的三年期间，他大部分时间 spent 在俄国，并于1935年10月15日乘坐“塞弗尔”号（s.s. Sever）轮船经海参崴返回上海。抵沪后，他入住天潼路422号新亚酒店。他于10月19日身体不适，后在虹桥路疗养院接受手术，终因腹膜炎于10月22日下午2时逝世。

经具名者暗中查访，显示戈先生出使海外纯粹是为了广泛研究新闻业，没有理由相信他曾怀有激进的政治倾向。他的个人品行赢得了熟人和同事的钦佩。

顾宝华
督察

副督察长（特科）

归档
1935年10月24日

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, OCTOBER 18, 1935

Mr. Kung-chen Ko, the Chinese
journalist, has returned to China fol-
lowing three years' stay in Europe
and Russia. Mr. Ko accompanied
the Lytton Commission back to
Geneva to attend the deliberations of
the League of Nations on the Report.
He was later appointed by the Chi-
nese Press Association to represent
China at the World Press Congress
in Spain, and later called on execu-
tives of various news agencies to dis-
cuss the exchange of news with Chi-
nese news associations. Interviewed
by pressmen on his arrival from
Vladivostok, Mr. Ko praised the work
of the Soviet in the Five-Year Plan
and declared that he sincerely be-
lieved the Chinese people could fol-
low their footsteps in rebuilding the
nation.

Sg

H
D.S. Kuh.
Report please.

《字林西报》，1935年10月18日，星期五

中国记者戈公振先生在结束为期三年的欧洲和俄国逗留后，已返回中国。戈先生曾陪同李顿调查团返回日内瓦，出席国际联盟关于该报告的审议会议。此后，他由中国新闻记者协会委派，代表中国参加在西班牙举行的世界报业大会，随后拜访了各通讯社的主管人员，商讨与中国新闻机构进行新闻交换事宜。在接受从海参崴抵达时的记者采访时，戈先生赞扬了苏联在五年计划方面的工作，并宣称他真诚地相信中国人民可以效仿他们的脚步来重建国家。
